Re: Error could not find or load main class edu.berkeley.cs.amplab.sparkr.SparkRBackend

Stijn Geuens Thanks for reporting this. Couple of things that would be good to check

  • Does the jar file C:/Users/s.geuens/Documents/R/win-library/3.1/SparkR/sparkr-assembly-0.1.jar exist ? If so could you check it size etc. ?
  • The other thing to check would be to see if the class does exist in the jar (i.e. if things got compiled correctly). I am not sure how to do this on Windows, but in Unix-based platforms I typically use something like `jar -tvf <jar_file> | grep edu.berkeley.cs.amplab.sparkr.SparkRBackend`
  • If both of those are valid, then its some problem with the way we are launching the java process. My guess is that this could be similar to https://sparkr.atlassian.net/browse/SPARKR-149 where we had a problem with space in the install path.
